subject: health
concept: Applying hygiene, nutrition variety, movement, sleep, safety, and feelings awareness to a full healthy-day routine, using the student's interest profile
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student builds a simple daily routine chart including hygiene, meals, movement, and sleep
exercise.abstract: Student explains why each part of their routine helps them stay healthy

assessment.mastery_threshold: routine includes all major healthy-habit categories from this unit in a reasonable way
misconception_flags: routine omits an entire major category (e.g. no sleep or no movement at all)

interest_binding: scenario generated fresh from student's stated interest profile
